name: XCC_BCE_DOCUMENT_TYPES
description: This table holds the enablement information for Budgetary Control and the Encumbrance Accounting for the document types related to the Project Expenditure transaction sources. It contains the document types that are not enabled for a specific Transaction Source. If the Transaction Source has the ALL_DOCUMENT_TYPE_FLAG set to Yes, no entries will exist in this table for that transaction source.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Corresponds to the business unit identifier.

columns.name: BUSINESS_FUNCTION_CODE
columns.description: it is the identifier of the business functions.

columns.name: DISABLEMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Represents whether the disablement is for Budgetary Control or Encumbrance Accounting.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Represents a document type related to a transaction source.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
